“陆先生，你要不要潜我？”时笙还靠着陆清韵，声音不轻不重。

夏满从她身边过去的时候，正好听到了，身子一歪，差点摔了。

她诡异的看了眼那个状似趴在男子怀中的女子，这个江晚，怎么那么奇葩？

“你回去多吃点木瓜，说不定我会考虑考虑的。”

木瓜？

时笙垂头看了眼胸部，脸色陡然难看起来。

这贱人竟然嫌老子胸小？

老子要打死他！

陆清韵推开时笙，笑容满面的威胁，“别跟着我，否则我会让你死得很难看。”

“不行，苏宜修把你交给我了，答应人家的事，我得做好。”时笙眼疾手快的拽着他，跑了她上哪儿逮人去。

“就算这样他也不会喜欢你的，他喜欢的是男人。”

喜欢男人？没看出来苏宜修竟然是这种人！

不是，干嘛要他喜欢？

时笙脑子懵了懵，等反应过来，陆清韵已经挣开他往人多的地方去了。

时笙黑着脸，抬腿追上去。

“陆清韵，你考虑考虑啊，你看我用处可多了，炒得了股，开得了公司，赚得了钱，坑得了人。你潜我那就是直接迎娶了一个人生赢家，像我这样的人才打着灯笼都找不着的，过了这个店就没这个村了。”

#宿主不要起脸来，天下无敌系列#

对于时笙的自我推销，陆大少采取无视，不过也没赶她走，那双眸子里笑盈盈的，不知在打什么坏主意。

时笙是有些戒备的，可是为了那个一掷千金，她也得硬着头皮上。

让陆清韵在她身上花钱，她觉得比自己赚钱给他花还要难！

两人一前一后的走在酒店的走廊上，陆清韵听着后面的声音，眸子里的笑意越来越浓。

“……陆清韵，我胸虽然小了点，但是它会长的，就算不会长，这也不错了。”

“我穷，潜不起。”陆清韵忍着笑，正儿八经的回了一句。

时笙：“……”

你丫的穷个屁啊！

作为最牛逼的反派，你后台那是硬得不能硬好不好，你怎么能说不行！！啊呸，说穷！

时笙正准备组织语言，谴责一下土豪装穷，是多么不厚道行为的时候，陆清韵忽然停了下来，他伸手拉了一把时笙，拐进安全通道中。

“陆……”

"Mr. Lu, do you want to infiltrate me?" Shi Sheng was still leaning against Lu Qingyun, her voice neither soft nor serious.

When Xia Man passed by her, she happened to hear it. Her body tilted and she almost fell.

She glanced strangely at the woman who seemed to be lying in the man's arms. Why is this Jiang Wan so weird?

"You go back and eat more papaya, maybe I will consider it."

Papaya?

Shi Sheng lowered his head and glanced at his chest, his face suddenly turned ugly.

This bitch actually thinks I have small breasts?

I'm going to beat him to death!

Lu Qingyun pushed Shi Sheng away with a threatening smile, "Don't follow me, or I will make you die ugly."

"No, Su Yixiu left you to me. I have to do what I promised you." Shi Sheng quickly grabbed him with quick eyes and hands, and ran away to catch someone.

"Even so, he won't like you. He likes men."

Like men?I didn't realize that Su Yixiu was this kind of person!

No, why should he like it?

Shi Sheng was confused. When he realized what he was doing, Lu Qingyun had already broken away from him and headed to a crowded place.

Shi Sheng had a dark face and raised his legs to catch up.

"Lu Qingyun, please think about it. You see, I have many uses. I can speculate in stocks, open companies, make money, and trick people. If you seduce me, you will directly marry a winner in life. Talents like me can't be found even with a lantern. After this store, there will be no village."

#host, don’t show your face, the world is invincible series#

Mr. Lu ignored Shi Sheng's self-promotion, but he didn't drive her away. There was a smile in his eyes, and he didn't know what bad idea he was planning.

Shi Sheng was a little wary, but for that big deal, she had to bite the bullet.

She found it even harder for Lu Qingyun to spend money on her than to make money for him!

The two of them walked in the corridor of the hotel one after another. The smile in Lu Qingyun's eyes grew stronger and stronger as she listened to the voices behind her.

"...Lu Qingyun, although my breasts are a bit small, they will grow. Even if they don't grow, it's not bad."

"I'm poor and can't afford to make a living." Lu Qingyun suppressed a smile and replied seriously.

Shi Sheng: "..."

You are so poor!

As the most awesome villain, you are so tough backstage, okay? How can you say no!!Ah, you are talking about poverty!

When Shi Sheng was about to formulate some words to condemn the unkind behavior of the wealthy people for pretending to be poor, Lu Qingyun suddenly stopped. He stretched out his hand to pull Shi Sheng and turned into the safe passage.

"Lu..."
